subject: How to show variable name when facet_wrap is used?

messages.author: c21e804e07c5e732
messages.subject: How to show variable name when facet_wrap is used?
parts:
Hi,

The following code only prints 4 panels with the 4 numbers, without
printing the parameter name "shape". It will be convenient to viewers
if such variable can be provided by default. Does anybody know the
simplest way to add such info in the generated figure? Thanks!

tmp=do.call(
rbind
, lapply(
c(.5, 1, 2, 5)
, function(shape) {
data.frame(
shape=shape,
x=rgamma(1000,shape=shape)
)
}
)
)
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(ggplot2))
p=qplot(x, data=tmp) + facet_wrap(~shape)
ggsave(p, file='main.png')

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: How to show variable name when facet_wrap is used?
parts:
Hi:

Here's one way:

tmp$fshape <- with(tmp, paste0('shape: ', shape))
qplot(x, data=tmp) + facet_wrap(~ fshape)

HTH,
Dennis
